Gcd(a,k)=1 makes all residue classes disjoint, yielding the complete classification, Hilbert series, genus and Frobenius. The k=2 parity tails imply the exact minimal generators by sharp minimum decomposition bounds. value.rationale: The result gives a full exact gap-set and Hilbert-series description for a motivated infinite two-parameter family of quotients whose divisor is one less than a generator. Its complexity depends on the generator difference k rather than a. At k=2 it supplies every minimal generator and constructs an infinite family of nonordinary maximal-embedding-dimension semigroups with unbounded multiplicity from only two source generators. This complete structural classification is more than an isolated small-parameter computation or a reused genus value.
